notes.title: Beta Access in no more! Thank You all Beta Gamers!
notes.content:
Hi Beta Gamers,

Thanks for your feedbacks. Since the game is ready for release tomorrow, we are revoking beta access today. Youtubers who have already reviewed our game or yet to review our game can contact us through press@firstseed.in for the full version key.

- Team

notes.title: Steam has approved the release! Hey ! Hey!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We are happy to tell you that Steam has approved our release on Apr 27!

- Team

notes.title: Very Excited! Just Few More Days!
notes.content:
Dear gamer!

We are much excited to present "Quest of Vidhuraa", a hard platformer game with cute story to you. Looking forward to see your expressions while playing the game.

:)

With Much Love
- Quest of Vidhuraa Team
